description: This file defines the CatalogContext class, which inherits from Entity Framework's DbContext. It configures the database sets for baskets, catalog items, brands, types, orders, and order items, and applies configurations during model creation.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: Represents the database context for the catalog, including DbSet properties for various entities and configuration setup.

methods.name: CatalogContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with provided options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply entity configurations from the current assembly during model creation.
